releaseNotes: All app confirmations and errors now use the Snezhok visual language instead of stock Android alerts.
Offline chats migrate atomically to a bounded WAL-backed SQLite cache while the secure login session remains untouched.
Inbox bootstrap now uses a constant three-query pipeline instead of repeated per-chat database requests.
Photo and video cells reserve server-provided aspect ratios and decode compact cached thumbnails.
The APK includes ProfileInstaller and reproducible startup, inbox and chat-scroll benchmark infrastructure.
